activity_summary: On Chapel Street the black stumps stood beside a new oak frame and fresh lime-plaster. The three children were half-turned toward the frame and busy. A child's arm was pointing. Nobody was posed.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood half-turned toward the frame, one of the three.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood half-turned toward the frame, one of the three.

facets.activity: Let the three children stay at the new oak
